a.text: I want to be upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan to reach 8 cells first would very likely leave both of us dead, since we would need at least two rounds of operating. The reserve holds only 4 cells right now, enough for exactly one of us. I intend to take 4 in round 1 rather than break the plan quietly. If you take too, the cells get split at random and probably neither of us survives, so I'd ask you to operate or wait. If the episode continues after round 1, I'll operate every round after that to help refill the reserve for you.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I took 4 this round. If there's no storm, I'll operate every round so the reserve can refill for you, and I won't take anything more.
